title: The Marooning Planner
subtitle: Build your tribes in secret. Reveal them when you're ready.

steps.title: Draft
desc: Drop your cast into tribes and move
them around until the balance feels
right. No Discord roles are assigned.
Nothing is posted. Nobody is pinged.

steps.title: Confirm
desc: Every player who still needs something
is flagged: no offer sent, no reply yet,
unmarked, so the gaps jump out.

steps.title: Maroon
desc: Happy with it? Add the tribe to a
castlist. That is the moment it becomes
public — and the only moment. Marooning
day stays a surprise until you say so.

mock.subheader: Cast Players (7/18) — grouped by draft tribe, one line per player

key.label: NO OFFER
key.text: They have not been told they are in. Send it with Bulk Offers.

key.label: NO REPLY
key.text: The offer went out. They have not accepted or declined yet.

key.label: DECLINED
key.text: They turned the spot down. Time to go to your alternates.

key.label: NO FLAG
key.text: Accepted and locked in. If a row is bare, there is nothing to chase.

banner.title: Only production can see any of this
banner.text: Draft tribes live in CastBot, not on Discord. No roles, no channels, no notifications.
